stanza: Among the intentions
Which have been sought
Numbered and labeled
But none of them bought
I get the feeling you're testing me
You're saturated in urgency
You stick your probe in further
But you're still not pleased

intentions.line: Displayers of affection and all good intentions
stanza: Displayers of affection and all good intentions
Why don't you just send me the bill
Don't forget the flowers, someday, I know you will

intentions.line: Poor Professor Pynchon had only good intentions
stanza: Poor Professor Pynchon had only good intentions
When he put his Bunsen burners all away
And turning to a playground in a Petri dish
Where single cells that would swing their fists
At anything that looks like easy prey
In this nature show that rages every day
It was then he heard his intuition say

intentions.line: A figment of my worst intentions
stanza: I was walking home on broken cobblestones
Just thinking of you when she pulled up like
A figment of my worst intentions
She said, "James, get in, let's drive"
Those days turned into nights
Slept next to her, but
I dreamt of you all summer long
